translation:
Numbness (ma), from the origin, has shallow and deep; also there is of the hands and feet and the whole body. Ma (numbness with sensation) is qi deficiency, it knows pain and itching; Buzhong Yiqi (Supplement-the-Centre and Benefit-Qi) may be made close kin.
Mu (wood/numbness without sensation) is blood deficiency, forgetting pain and itching; Erchen (Two-Matured) truly should not linger and stop. Much of it combines damp-phlegm and dead blood; Qingfeng Tang Yin (Clear-the-Wind Beverage) may be searched out.
Qingfeng Yin (Clear-the-Wind Beverage) with Zhu (Baizhu/Atractylodes) and Jinyinhua (Honeysuckle); Binglang (Areca), Bixie, Ban (Banxia/Pinellia) and Mugua (Chaenomeles). Dang Gui, Qin (Huangqin/Scutellaria), Shao (Peony) and Ganjiang (Dried Ginger), Qianghuo (Notopterygium) and Chenpi and Wuyao (Lindera) — equally praiseworthy.
translator_notes: 麻=ma (tingling numbness, qi deficiency); 木=mu (dense numbness without sensation, blood deficiency).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Mania (dian) and frenzy (kuang), the two conditions, have yin and yang; dian (depressive mania) belongs to double yin, kuang (frenetic mania) belongs to yang. Anger rushing to the crown, spleen-fire replete; open-eyed and bold, speaking chaotic nonsense.
Not avoiding kinsfolk and strangers, naked body dancing — the frenzy condition may be made clear and asserted. Lost-soul and fallen-spirit, losing the heart's intent; foolish-stupid, laughing alone and grieving alone.
This is the dian condition, how could it be hard to recognize? Evil-specter mania, distinguish it — burn a stick of incense. Yuanzhi Huatan Tang (Polygala Transform-Phlegm Decoction) weigh and use; regulate nutrient and nourish the stomach, think carefully.
Yuanzhi Huatan (Polygala Transform-Phlegm) with Ban (Banxia/Pinellia), Bai (Baifu/Aconite?), Fuling and Chenpi; Zhusha (Cinnabar) and Suanzooren (Sour Jujube Seed). Shipu (Acorus/Shichangpu), Dansheng (Bile-Arisaema), Jinbo (Gold leaf) and Qi (...); Tianma (Gastrodia), Zexie (Alisma), Zhuling and Fuling.

Treat-Goat-Epilepsy Formula
Dansheng (Bile-Arisaema), Quanxie (Scorpion), Niuhuang (Cow Bezoar), Baifuzi (Typhonium), Jiangcan (Bombyx), Fangfeng (Ledebouriella), Tianma (Gastrodia), Shexiang (Musk).
Together with jujube, weighing in quicksilver (mercury) five fen into the medicinals, made into pills, taken with Jing-ai and ginger decoction.
unresolved: "金箔氣" obscure; likely 金箔 for calming.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
For the epilepsy (xian) condition the formularies list five names; now people call the various epilepsies dizzy-dancing. Before birth, in the mother's womb, it caught fright and marvel; after exiting the mother's womb, phlegm-qi invades.
Suddenly stiff and fallen, streaming drool and foam; mouth and eyes deviated, the limbs bent and stretched. The sound being like an animal call, thereby it takes its name; in a moment it revives, unaware of the circumstances.
If heaven loses its duty (proper up-down), the turbid occupies the upper; the wood-general (liver) may be cleared and purged. Qingxin Wendan Tang (Clear-the-Heart Warm-the-Gallbladder Decoction) yields to none; the method of treatment does not escape the interior and exterior causes.
Qingxin Wendan (Clear-the-Heart Warm-the-Gallbladder) with Erchen (Two-Matured) all complete; Renshen (Ginseng), Yuanzhi (Polygala), Chuanxiong and Maimen (Ophiopogon). Shipu (Acorus), Xiangfu (Cyperus), Baishao and Zhu (Atractylodes); Huanglian (Coptis), Zhishi (Immature Bitter Orange) and Zhuru (Bamboo Shavings) all complete.
translator_notes: 五癇=the five epilepsies (named after the animal cries).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
